instruction: Assist me in setting up the FastAPI development environment for a web API project. The repository is located at "https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi" and should be cloned to /home/user. Please refer to the tutorial at https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/ for setup guidance.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting up FastAPI web framework development environment: cloning repository to /home/user, installing in editable mode, and verifying successful import. Uses custom getter and metric to verify all three requirements with partial credit scoring.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Partial credit scoring: 0.4 for repository cloned to /home/user/fastapi, 0.3 for FastAPI installed in editable mode from cloned repo, 0.3 for import succeeds. Total: 1.0 for complete setup.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete requirement coverage: Getter correctly checks all three requirements - (1) repository cloned to /home/user/fastapi via .git directory check (line 35-40), (2) editable install verification using pip list -e and pip show (line 42-62), (3) import success test (line 64-78)

Correct distinction between approaches: Evaluator can distinguish between simple 'pip install fastapi' (score=0.3, only import passes), cloning without installing (score=0.4, only repo exists), and full correct setup (score=1.0, all checks pass)

Robust editable install verification: Uses multiple checks including 'pip list -e' for editable packages and 'pip show fastapi' to verify Location field contains '/home/user/fastapi', correctly identifying development mode installation
Appropriate partial credit scoring: Implements sensible weighting (0.4 for repo, 0.3 for editable install, 0.3 for import) that rewards progress while requiring all steps for full credit
Good error handling: Getter captures import errors and properly handles edge cases with fallback checks for editable install verification
